extracted.name: Spinach and Strawberry Salad with Feta Cheese
extracted.description: Spinach salad with strawberries is a summertime natural. This version adds feta cheese and provides a homemade balsamic vinaigrette.
ingredient_lines: 1 (16 ounce) package fresh strawberries, hulled and quartered
1 (8 ounce) package feta cheese, cut into squares
instruction_lines: Toss strawberries, spinach, and feta cheese together in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, brown sugar, white balsamic vinegar, sesame seeds, poppy seeds, and paprika together in a bowl; drizzle over salad and toss to coat.
